A currently enrolled student can request an official transcript in Arabic or English by accessing the Current Students Documents service through the official UAEU portal or app using UAE Pass or university credentials, then selecting either Academic Transcript Arabic or Academic Transcript English and submitting the request.

After submitting the request, the student can track it in the My Requests section and will receive the processed transcript at their university email address.
